_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Ove uya tala Golf (Ombandi ya Kadi) - Omutala {player_id}.
Ondjokonona: Fikisa ondjambi ya kule nombali mokati kwa rondi iyi. Ihe ombali ya kule nombali ya kule nombali, ove ikwameka kwa 0.
Ombandi ya Kadi: A=1, 2-10=onombali ya kule nombali, J/Q=10, K=0

Ove ikwameka (use ombakwa oya):
- '[draw]' - Koka oku ya dekki
- '[take]' - Koka oku ya kadi ya kule
- '[swap X Y]' - Koka oku ya kadi ya kule na posha X (mbali) Y (kule)
- '[discard]' - Koka oku ya kadi ya kule

board.drew:
Ove koka: {card}
Elo ove ikwameka [swap X Y] kana [discard] oku.
board.took:
Ove koka: {card} oku ya kadi ya kule
Elo ove ikwameka [swap X Y] oku (kana ikwameka kule).

options.final_turns: Ove na rondi za mwisho! Ove ikwameka: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: O sukila oku: [swap X Y] (oku yuvula oku pesila okokanda posi)
options.swap_or_discard: Ove o sukila oku: [swap X Y] ale [discard]

hand.no_cards: Ka tu kuete okokanda koku eca olombanjaile.

message.deck_empty: Ocimunga comanu vocila caco colomapalo, ca liwekapo.
message.knocked: Omutu {pid} anateta! Omutu kehe mwe kwatele kwa kudipanda kimo.
message.final_round: Omutu {pid} {reason}! Omutu kehe mwe kwatele kwa kudipanda kimo.

invalid.wrong_action: Koka ombakwa oya moja: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], kana [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Okasia yoku kapa ulela, ka ya kuatele vali esilivilo!
invalid.must_draw_first: Elo ove ikwameka koka [draw], [take], [knock], kana [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Poku ci linga, ka mu iñila ovava.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Omana kadi. Ona omane [swap X Y] or [discard] iyayo.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Pole, o sukila oku kuata uloño woku a soneha.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Momo, o sukila oku tambula ukombe umue okuti, ka ca lelukile oku u sanga.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Ngolo ili pano. Utume ngolo 1-{max_row}, koloni 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Poku ci linga, ka mu iñila ovava.
invalid.already_knocked: Pole, omanu vakuavo va siata oku eca olombongo vialua oco vi kuatise epata liavo.
invalid.already_revealed: Ovikele viaco, via eciwa komanu vosi!
